metrics.final_mean: Mean validation score of the final policy (50 episodes), averaged over seeds
metrics.best_mean: Best periodic validation mean during training, averaged over seeds
metrics.auc: Normalised area under the validation learning curve (sample efficiency)
metrics.steps_to_25: Median environment steps to reach validation mean >= 25 (lower is better)
metrics.steps_to_50: Median environment steps to reach validation mean >= 50 (lower is better)
metrics.steps_to_100: Median environment steps to reach validation mean >= 100 (lower is better)
metrics.ood_mean: Mean over out-of-distribution test scenarios (confirmatory evaluations only)
